name: Pho Royal
blocked: fetch-failed: TLS handshake fails server-side on every attempt (curl/schannel: SEC_E_INTERNAL_ERROR; WebFetch/OpenSSL: TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR) - confirmed not a local network issue since unrelated HTTPS sites (google.com) succeed and plain HTTP to the same host answers 200/301. No ordering-platform presence found via web search (DoorDash/UberEats/Grubhub searches for this restaurant return nothing).
notes: Router already found this fetch-failed; re-confirmed with retries, forced TLS1.2, http1.1, and WebFetch - all fail identically, pointing to a broken TLS config on the restaurant's own server rather than a transient network blip.

The restaurant's own site (cocobombusa.com) lists two locations - Linda Vista (2379 Ulric St, no ordering link, just hours) and Convoy Street (4690 Convoy St Suite B103), which is the ONLY branch with a Toast storefront (/menu, /order both resolve to the Convoy St restaurant, confirmed by address text and Toast restaurant GUID 9d76df47-...). Filing Convoy's menu under this id would repeat the router's wrong-branch problem. Yelp biz page matching this address (yelp.com/biz/coco-bomb-san-diego-3) 403s; checkle.com is Vercel-bot-walled.
notes: Needs a browser to reach Yelp menu photos for the Linda Vista storefront specifically, or a future online-ordering signup by that branch.

blocked: needs-browser: found a NetWaiter storefront (cancunmexicanseafood.netwaiter.com) whose About page address matches exactly (1766 N Coast Hwy 101 B, Encinitas), but GetMenu returns {"Groups":[],"ExternalType":null} and the page itself carries CanOrder:false - genuinely no menu on this channel per the playbook's NetWaiter rule. name: Jochi Resto Grill
notes: No usable official website (listed site redirects to a barred directory farm, edan.io). Found a TripAdvisor review photo of the restaurant's actual in-store menu board; the TripAdvisor listing's address (Orange Ave, Chula Vista, CA 91911) matches the work list. Board sections read: Combo Plates/Regular Items, Specialty Items, Mix Combo Plates, Spaghetti/Pancit Palabok & Pancit Malabon, Fish Items, Ala Carte, Sisig/Bopis/Lechon Paksiw and Beef Dishes, Regular Pancit, Drink, Desserts, and a separate 'Party Trays & Lechon (Half Tray)' section - excluded as adjunct catering per playbook. One fish item's name was obscured in the photo by a figurine on the counter and its price is omitted for that reason. Fried Calamare, Lechon Kawali and Lechon Cebu are priced per pound (as posted); Lumpia Shanghai is priced per 100 pieces (as posted) - these are the restaurant's own published units, not derived. Fried Tilapia's two posted prices ($6.00/$6.50) are both directly read off the board for its two sizes.

name: Tandoor
blocked: implausible price level: restaurant's own site (tandoorsandiego.com, address confirmed 5608 Mission Center Road) is intact, first-party, and prices every item with no markup pattern - but it is a circa-2008-2012 era plain-HTML page (samosas $2.99, chicken tikka masala $12.99, a la carte entrees $5.89-$9.99), far below current San Diego Indian entree prices ($16-25). This exact restaurant and this exact price level is already documented in probe/FINDINGS.md as a previously-blocked case for the same reason. Re-checked for a newer source: no DoorDash/UberEats storefront for this address turns up (only unrelated same-cuisine restaurants under similar names, e.g. 'Punjabi Tandoor' at a different address) - FINDINGS also separately warns two other 'Tandoor' listings on DoorDash/iMenu4u resolve to 6755 Mira Mesa Blvd, a different restaurant, not this one.
notes: Do not file the tandoorsandiego.com HTML menu despite it being complete and unmarked-up - the numbers themselves are the tell. Needs a current dine-in photo or a real ordering platform for this exact address (5608 Mission Center Rd #902) to clear.

name: West End Pub
blocked: fetch-failed: westendpb.com has no DNS record at all (curl: 'Could not resolve host'). Searched once for a newer domain per the playbook rule for dead DNS - none found; every current listing (Yelp, restaurantguru, atly, wanderboat, sandiegolineup) still points back to the same dead westendpb.com as 'the website'. A Facebook page exists (facebook.com/westypb/) but returns 400 to a plain curl (requires JS/login). This is a bar with an actual food menu (paninis, pretzels, Philly cheesesteaks, quesadillas per third-party descriptions), not a drinks-only dive, so not eligible for not_found; no page with directly-verified prices was reached.
notes: Needs a browser to check the Facebook page's photos/posts, or Yelp menu photos, for a dine-in artefact with prices.

name: Flora
notes: Restaurant's own site (floranorthpark.com, address confirmed 3021 University Ave) links to its real brunch-menu PDF, but the PDF's entree prices are rendered in a way pdftotext cannot extract at all (-layout and -raw both give clean dish names/descriptions with no attached numbers for every entree), and probe/extract_pdf_images.js found no embedded JPEGs to fall back on - genuinely unrecoverable for the entrees. The PDF's 'Sides' list (Flora hasselback potatoes, applewood smoked bacon, house potatoes, sausage, mixed fruit, man candy bacon, avocado) DOES extract cleanly with prices attached. Found brunchspotter.com's brunch writeup, which transcribes the full brunch menu with prices in plain text (address and phone confirmed matching); its 7 Sides prices match the PDF's own Sides prices exactly, item for item, which is why this is filed with medium rather than low confidence despite the primary read being third-party. Site's /menus page lists only 'Brunch Menu' and 'Drink Menu' (hours posted are brunch-only, 9am-3pm weekdays / 8am-3pm weekends) despite homepage marketing copy alluding to a dinner service - no dinner menu was found anywhere, so none is filed; this may mean dinner is not currently offered. The restaurant's own Drinks PDF separately gave a clean, unambiguous wine/beer list (raw-text mode kept each column's name-block and price-block separate and in matching order, unlike -layout which interleaved the two columns); its cocktails have no name field (just a witty tagline + ingredients) and no visible price anywhere in the PDF, so cocktails are excluded entirely. 'Coffee' and 'Non-Alcoholic' drink categories are posted only as ranges ($4-$6, $5-$7, $4-$8) with no breakdown of which specific drink costs what, so no rows were written for them.
